## 1. CLEAR ENVIRONMENT
```{r clear-env}
  ######################### CLEAN ENVIRONMENT   ######################### 
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) # Remove all objects from the work space
gc()  # Garbage collection to free memory

options(
  max.print = 1e5,  #Reasonable cap to avoid massive console dumps
  scipen = 0, # Use scientific notation
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, # Keep strings as character by default
  dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, # Suppress dplyr's summaries
  digits = 3 # Number of digits when printing
  )

  ######################### PROJECT INFO  ######################### 
info <- list(
  Title = "SPLIT-GFP TRAP ANALYSIS",
  R_Version = R.version$version.string,
  Working_Directory = getwd(),
  Timestamp = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))

separator <- strrep("=", 80)
cat("\n", separator, "\n", info$Title, "\n", separator, "\n")
cat("R Version:", info$R_Version, "\n")
cat("Working Directory:", info$Working_Directory, "\n")
cat("Timestamp:", info$Timestamp, "\n\n")

## Optional: show session info for reproducibility
# sessionInfo()
```

## 2. INSTALL PACKAGES
```{r install-packages, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}
  ######################### LOAD REQ PACKAGES  ######################### 
required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse", # dplyr, ggplot2, tidyr, purrr, stringr, readr
  "DESeq2", # Differential expression analysis
  "patchwork", # Combine multiple ggplot objects
  "ggrepel", # Add non-overlapping text labels to ggplot2
  "pheatmap", # Clustered heat maps
  "AnnotationDbi", # Gene annotation framework
  "org.At.tair.db", # Arabidopsis thaliana annotations
  "clusterProfiler", # GO/KEGG enrichment analysis and GSEA
  "enrichplot", # Visualization of enrichment results
  "vidger", # RNA-seq viz helpers         
  "apeglm", # LFC shrinkage  
  "RColorBrewer", # Color palettes
  "reshape2", # Data reshaping
  "dendextend", # Dendrogram
  "writexl", # Excel export
  "tibble", # Tibbles
  "ggdendro",
  "EnhancedVolcano"
)

  ######################### INSTALL MISSING PACKAGES  ######################### 
# new_packages <- required_packages[!(required_packages %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"])]
# if (length(new_packages)) {
#   install.packages(new_packages)
# }
# Load packages quietly
load_ok <- sapply(
  required_packages,
  function(pkg) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(
      require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)
    )
  }
)
if (!all(load_ok)) {
  warning("Failed to load packages: ",
          paste(required_packages[!load_ok], collapse = ", "))
}

  ######################### SET WORKING DIRECTORY  ######################### 
cat("Working directory:", getwd(), "\n")
```

## 3. SET DIRECTORIES
```{r setup-paths, include=FALSE}
  ######################### SET OUTPUT DIRECTORY  ######################### 
graphics_dir <- file.path("Results/Graphics")
tables_dir   <- file.path("Results/Tables") 
procdata_dir <- file.path("Results/Processed_data")

dirs <- c(graphics_dir, tables_dir, procdata_dir)

# Create directories if they don't exist
invisible(
  sapply(
    dirs,
    function(d) {
      if (!dir.exists(d)) {
        dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
      }
    }
  )
)
## Print confirmation
cat("Directories ready:\n")
cat("- Graphics: ", graphics_dir, "\n")
cat("- Tables:   ", tables_dir, "\n")
cat("- Proc:     ", procdata_dir, "\n")
```

## 4. READ IN FILES
```{r read-couts, message=FALSE}
  ######################### LOAD featureCounts WHOLE GENOME ALIGNMENT ######################### 
featcount <- read_tsv("../HvIM/Data_Repository/featcount.txt", skip = 1)
count_cols <- colnames(featcount)[7:ncol(featcount)]
read.count <- featcount %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(count_cols)) %>%
  as.matrix()
rownames(read.count) <- featcount[[1]]

## Checks
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rownames(read.count)))
stopifnot(is.numeric(read.count[1, ]))
```

## 5. META DATA
```{r Meta, message=FALSE}
## Standardize colnames
sample_names <- c("IT-107", "IT-108", "IT-109", "IT-110", 
                  "H-107", "H-108", "H-109", "H-110", "H-111",
                  "UT-106", "UT-108", "UT-114", 
                  "IT-206", "IT-207", "IT-208", "IT-209",
                  "IM-206", "IM-207", "IM-208", "IM-209", "IM-210",
                  "UT-204", "UT-208", "UT-213", "UT214",
                  "UM-204", "UM-208", "UM-213", "UM-214", "UM-215")
colnames(read.count) <- sample_names #save naming system

## Verify structure
cat("📊 Counts loaded:", nrow(read.count), "genes x", ncol(read.count), "samples\n")

## Convert matrix → data frame with gene IDs
raw_counts_df <- as.data.frame(read.count)
raw_counts_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(raw_counts_df, "GeneID")

# Export both CSV and Excel
write_csv(raw_counts_df, file.path(tables_dir, "raw_counts_clean.csv"))
writexl::write_xlsx(raw_counts_df, file.path(tables_dir, "raw_counts_clean.xlsx"))
```

## 6. EXTRACT H IM UM
```{r setup-count-data}
## Columns to DROP: IT(1:4,13:16), UT(10:12,22:25) → KEEP 5-9,17-21,26-30
keep_cols <- c(5:9, 17:21, 26:30)
ImvHvUM <- read.count[, keep_cols]
colnames(ImvHvUM)  # Confirm order
cat("📊 Counts loaded:", nrow(ImvHvUM), "genes x", ncol(ImvHvUM), "samples\n")

sample_info<- data.frame(
  row.names = c("H-107", "H-108", "H-109", "H-110", "H-111", 
                "IM-206", "IM-207", "IM-208", "IM-209", "IM-210", 
                "UM-204", "UM-208", "UM-213", "UM-214", "UM-215"),
  Groups = factor(c(rep("H",5), rep("IM",5), rep("UM",5)), levels=c("UM","IM","H")),
  Condition = factor(c(rep("Infected",10), rep("Uninfected",5)))
)
stopifnot(all(rownames(sample_info) == colnames(ImvHvUM)))

ImvHvUM_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(as.matrix(ImvHvUM)), "GeneID")

write_csv(ImvHvUM_df, file.path(tables_dir, "counts_IM_H_UM_cleansubset.csv"))
writexl::write_xlsx(ImvHvUM_df, file.path(tables_dir, "counts_IM_H_UM_cleansubset.xlsx"))

cat("✅ IM/H/UM subset ready:", ncol(ImvHvUM), "samples\n")
table(sample_info$Groups)
```

## 7. SET COLORS
```{r Colors}
colors <- c("H"="blue", "IM"="hotpink", "UM"="black", "UT"="lightgreen", "IT"="purple")
```

## 8. RUN DESeq
```{r DESeq-run}
  ######################### RUN DESEQ  ######################### 
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = ImvHvUM,
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ Groups)

## Prefilter low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep, ]
## UM reference
dds$Groups <- relevel(dds$Groups, ref = "UM")
cat("📊 Counts loaded:", nrow(dds), "genes x", ncol(dds), "samples\n")

## Run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds, sfType = "poscounts")
## Save full DESeq object
saveRDS(dds, file.path(procdata_dir, "dds_IM_H_UM.rds"))

cat("Size factors:", round(sizeFactors(dds), 3), "\n")
```

## 9. DESEQ Results
```{r DESeq-results}
  ######################### RESULTS   ######################### 
res_IM_UM <- results(dds, name = "Groups_IM_vs_UM", alpha = 0.05)
res_H_UM  <- results(dds, name = "Groups_H_vs_UM", alpha = 0.05)

cat("IM vs UM DEGs (padj<0.05):", sum(res_IM_UM$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("H vs UM DEGs (padj<0.05): ", sum(res_H_UM$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

## 10. VOLCANO PLOTS
```{r}
 #########################  VOLCANO PLOTS   #########################  
res_H_UM_df <- res_H_UM %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Gene") %>% filter(!is.na(padj)) %>% arrange(padj)
res_IM_UM_df <- res_IM_UM %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Gene") %>% filter(!is.na(padj)) %>% arrange(padj)

# H vs UM volcano
EnhancedVolcano(
  res_H_UM_df,
  lab = res_H_UM_df$Gene,
  x = "log2FoldChange",
  y = "padj",
  pCutoff = 0.05,
  FCcutoff = 1,
  pointSize = 1.5,
  labSize = 3,
  title = "H vs UM",
  subtitle = paste("Total DE:", sum(res_H_UM_df$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)),
  caption = "Haustoria TRAP-seq"
)
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "Volcano_H_vs_UM.png"), width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# IM vs UM volcano  
EnhancedVolcano(
  res_IM_UM_df,
  lab = res_IM_UM_df$Gene,
  x = "log2FoldChange",
  y = "padj",
  pCutoff = 0.05,
  FCcutoff = 1,
  pointSize = 1.5,
  labSize = 3,
  title = "IM vs UM (infection response)",
  subtitle = paste("Total DE:", sum(res_IM_UM_df$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)),
  caption = "Infection Result TRAP-seq"
)
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "Volcano_IM_vs_UM.png"), width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

## Write Results
writexl::write_xlsx(list(
  "H_vs_UM" = res_H_UM_df,
  "IM_vs_UM" = res_IM_UM_df),
  file.path(tables_dir, "DESeq2_Results.xlsx"))
```

## 11. VST NORMALIZATION
```{r Normalization}
  #########################  VST   #########################  
## Variance stabilizing transformation
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE, nsub = 1000)  # blind ignores design; subsample for speed

## Sample names, match to colData
colnames(vsd) <- rownames(sample_info)
stopifnot(all(colnames(vsd) == rownames(colData(dds))))  # Check

## Normalized counts matrix (size factors applied)
norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)

cat("VST dims:", nrow(vsd), "genes ×", ncol(vsd), "samples\n")
cat("Norm counts dims:", nrow(norm_counts), "×", ncol(norm_counts), "\n")

## EXPORT
write_csv(as.data.frame(norm_counts), 
          file.path(tables_dir, "normalized_counts_H_IM_UM.csv"))

writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    Normalized = as.data.frame(round(norm_counts, 2)),  # Round for readability
    VST = as.data.frame(assay(vsd))), 
  path = file.path(tables_dir, "H_IM_UM_normalized_VST.xlsx"))
cat("✅ Exported Normalized + VST matrices to Tables/\n")

## Enhanced quality checks
summary(colSums(assay(vsd)))  # VST lib sizes should be ~equal (~1e6 range)

## Better visualization
boxplot(log2(assay(vsd)[1:25, ] + 1), 
        main = "VST Top 25 Genes by Sample", 
        las = 2, cex.axis = 0.8)
```



```{r clustering-heatmeps}
## Sample correlation heatmap (Spearman, raw counts >=1)
sim_mat <- ImvHvUM[rowSums(ImvHvUM) >= 1, ]
cor_samps <- cor(assay(vsd), method = "spearman")
melted_cor <- reshape2::melt(cor_samps)

## Correlation Plot
p_cor <- ggplot(melted_cor, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = value), color = "black", size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0.75, limits = c(0.5, 1), name = "Spearman ρ") +
  labs(title = "Sample Correlation (Raw Counts, Spearman)", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")
print(p_cor)
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "sample_correlation_spearman.png"), p_cor, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)


## Hierarchical clustering (VST normalized, Euclidean distance)
sample_dist <- dist(t(assay(vsd)))  # t samples as rows
hc <- hclust(sample_dist, method = "ward.D2")
dend_data <- ggdendro::dendro_data(hc)


p_dend <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = ggdendro::segment(dend_data), 
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, colour = color), 
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  scale_colour_identity() +  # Use exact colors
  coord_flip() + 
  scale_y_reverse(expand = c(0.2, 0)) +
  ggdendro::theme_dendro() + 
  labs(title = "VST Clustering (Ward.D2)", 
       subtitle = "Labels colored by Groups (Haustoria/Infected Mesophyll/Uninfected Mesophyll)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
#print(p_dend)

#ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "sample_clustering_colored.png"), 
#       p_dend, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)


## Sample distance matrix heatmap
dist_mat <- as.matrix(sample_dist)
colnames(dist_mat) <- rownames(sample_info) 
rownames(dist_mat) <- rownames(sample_info)

colors_dist <- colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues")))(255)
p_dist <- pheatmap(dist_mat,
  clustering_distance_rows = sample_dist,
  clustering_distance_cols = sample_dist,
  color = colors_dist,
  main = "Sample Euclidean Distances (VST)",
  show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,
  filename = file.path(graphics_dir, "sample_distance_heatmap.png"),
  width = 10, height = 9
)
```

## PCA AND PLOT
```{r PCA}
#########################  PCA PLOT   #########################  
pca_data <- DESeq2::plotPCA(vsd, 
                           intgroup = c("Groups", "Condition"), 
                           returnData = TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"))

# Plot
p_pca <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Groups, shape = Condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 4.5, stroke = 1.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, name = "Tissue") +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = name),                 
                  box.padding = 0.35, 
                  max.overlaps = Inf,  # Show all labels
                  size = 3.5, 
                  segment.color = "red",
                  segment.size = 0.3,
                  bg.color = "white", 
                  bg.r = 0.1) +
  labs(title = "TRAP-seq PCA: Haustoria vs Mesophyll (VST)",
       subtitle = paste("PC1:", round(percentVar[1],1), "% variance |",
                       "PC2:", round(percentVar[2],1), "% variance"),
       caption = "Groups: UM (uninfected mesophyll), IM (infected mesophyll), H (haustoria)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(p_pca)

## EXPORT
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "TRAPseq_PCA_vst.png"), 
       p_pca, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## LFC SHRINKAGE + ARRANGEMENT + CLEAN
```{r DESeq-results-lfc}
#########################  LFC SHRINKAGE   #########################  
lfc_H_UM <- tryCatch({
  lfcShrink(dds, coef = "Groups_H_vs_UM", type = "apeglm")
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("apeglm failed for H_vs_UM, using normal: ", e$message)
  lfcShrink(dds, contrast = c("Groups", "H", "UM"), type = "normal")
})

lfc_IM_UM <- tryCatch({
  lfcShrink(dds, coef = "Groups_IM_vs_UM", type = "apeglm")
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("apeglm failed for IM_vs_UM, using normal: ", e$message)
  lfcShrink(dds, contrast = c("Groups", "IM", "UM"), type = "normal")
})

  #########################  ARRANGING AND CLEAN   #########################  
# padj ascending, remove NA padj
res_H_UM <- res_H_UM[!is.na(res_H_UM$padj), ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(padj)
res_IM_UM <- res_IM_UM[!is.na(res_IM_UM$padj), ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(padj)

lfc_H_UM <- lfc_H_UM[!is.na(lfc_H_UM$padj), ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(padj)
lfc_IM_UM <- lfc_IM_UM[!is.na(lfc_IM_UM$padj), ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(padj)

## Clean up time
pad <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff <- 1.0

res_H_UM_df <- res_H_UM %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Gene") %>% filter(!is.na(padj)) %>% arrange(padj)
res_IM_UM_df <- res_IM_UM %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Gene") %>% filter(!is.na(padj)) %>% arrange(padj)

lfc_H_UM_df <- lfc_H_UM %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Gene") %>% filter(!is.na(padj)) %>% arrange(padj)
lfc_IM_UM_df <- lfc_IM_UM %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Gene") %>% filter(!is.na(padj)) %>% arrange(padj)


# QC summaries
sig_H_UM <- sum(res_H_UM_df$padj < pad & abs(res_H_UM_df$log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff)
sig_IM_UM <- sum(res_IM_UM_df$padj < pad & abs(res_IM_UM_df$log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff)

cat("\n🔬 DEGs (padj <", pad, "|LFC| ≥", lfc_cutoff, "):\n")
cat("H vs UM:  ", sig_H_UM, " (", round(100*sig_H_UM/nrow(res_H_UM),1), "%)\n")
cat("IM vs UM: ", sig_IM_UM, " (", round(100*sig_IM_UM/nrow(res_IM_UM),1), "%)\n")
cat("H > IM confirms haustoria enrichment!\n\n")

## EXPORT CSV
write_csv(res_H_UM_df, file.path(tables_dir, "DESeq2_H_vs_UM_base.csv"))
write_csv(lfc_H_UM_df, file.path(tables_dir, "DESeq2_H_vs_UM_LFCshrink.csv"))
write_csv(res_IM_UM_df, file.path(tables_dir, "DESeq2_IM_vs_UM_base.csv"))
write_csv(lfc_IM_UM_df, file.path(tables_dir, "DESeq2_IM_vs_UM_LFCshrink.csv"))
cat("✅ Exported 4 result tables (base + LFC-shrunk)\n")


# Set up for excel
export_list <- list(
  "H_vs_UM_results" = res_H_UM_df,
  "IM_vs_UM_results" = res_IM_UM_df,
  "H_vs_UM_LFC"     = lfc_H_UM_df,
  "IM_vs_UM_LFC"    = lfc_IM_UM_df
)

writexl::write_xlsx(export_list, path = file.path(tables_dir, "DESeq2_results.xlsx"))
cat("✅ DESeq2 results saved as Excel at:", file.path(tables_dir, "DESeq2_results.xlsx"), "\n")


sum(lfc_H_UM_df$padj < pad & abs(lfc_H_UM_df$log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff)

sum(lfc_IM_UM_df$padj < pad & abs(lfc_IM_UM_df$log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff)
```


```{r DESeq-results-lfc}
library(DESeq2)

# --- H vs UM ---
lfc_H_UM_raw <- tryCatch({
  lfcShrink(dds, coef = "Groups_H_vs_UM", type = "apeglm")
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("apeglm failed for H_vs_UM, using normal: ", e$message)
  lfcShrink(dds, contrast = c("Groups", "H", "UM"), type = "normal")
})

# Base MA plot
plotMA(lfc_H_UM_raw, ylim = c(-5,5), alpha = 0.05, main = "H vs UM")

# Highlight significant genes in red
sig_H <- lfc_H_UM_raw$padj < 0.05 & abs(lfc_H_UM_raw$log2FoldChange) >= 1
points(
  log2(lfc_H_UM_raw$baseMean[sig_H] + 1),   # x-axis: mean expression
  lfc_H_UM_raw$log2FoldChange[sig_H],       # y-axis: LFC
  col = "red",
  pch = 16,
  cex = 0.6
)

# --- IM vs UM ---
lfc_IM_UM_raw <- tryCatch({
  lfcShrink(dds, coef = "Groups_IM_vs_UM", type = "apeglm")
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("apeglm failed for IM_vs_UM, using normal: ", e$message)
  lfcShrink(dds, contrast = c("Groups", "IM", "UM"), type = "normal")
})

plotMA(lfc_IM_UM_raw, ylim = c(-5,5), alpha = 0.05, main = "IM vs UM")

sig_IM <- lfc_IM_UM_raw$padj < 0.05 & abs(lfc_IM_UM_raw$log2FoldChange) >= 1
points(
  log2(lfc_IM_UM_raw$baseMean[sig_IM] + 1),
  lfc_IM_UM_raw$log2FoldChange[sig_IM],
  col = "red",
  pch = 16,
  cex = 0.6
)
```


```{r}
## Single wide tibble (LFC shrunk)
deseq_all <- full_join(
  as_tibble(lfc_IM_UM, rownames = "GeneID") %>% 
    dplyr::select(GeneID, log2FoldChange, padj, pvalue)
  %>% mutate(contrast = "IM_vs_UM"),
  as_tibble(lfc_H_UM, rownames = "GeneID") %>% 
    dplyr::select(GeneID, log2FoldChange, padj, pvalue)
  %>% mutate(contrast = "H_vs_UM"),
  by = "GeneID",
  suffix = c("_IM_vs_UM", "_H_vs_UM")) %>%
dplyr::select(GeneID, ends_with("log2FoldChange"), ends_with("padj"), 
                ends_with("pvalue"), everything()) %>%
  arrange(padj_IM_vs_UM, padj_H_vs_UM)

# Add sig or not
deseq_all <- deseq_all %>%
  mutate(
    sig_IM = ifelse(padj_IM_vs_UM < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange_IM_vs_UM) > 1, 
                    "Significant", "NS"),
    sig_H  = ifelse(padj_H_vs_UM < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange_H_vs_UM) > 1, 
                    "Significant", "NS")
  )
## EXPORT
write_csv(deseq_all, file.path(tables_dir, "DESeq2_LFC_shrunk_all_contrasts.csv"))
writexl::write_xlsx(deseq_all, path = file.path(tables_dir, "DESeq2_LFC_shrunk_all_contrast.xlsx"))

# Full DE summary table
summary_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  contrast = c("IM_vs_UM", "H_vs_UM"),
  n_DEG = c(
    sum(res_IM_UM$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(res_H_UM$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  n_LFC1 = c(
    sum(res_IM_UM$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_IM_UM$log2FoldChange) >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(res_H_UM$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_H_UM$log2FoldChange) >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

summary_tbl
```


```{r deg-heatmap}
set.seed(123)

## DE genes from BOTH contrasts (intersecting for haustoria candidates)
sig_IM <- rownames(res_IM_UM)[res_IM_UM$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(res_IM_UM$padj) & abs(res_IM_UM$log2FoldChange) >= 1]

sig_H  <- rownames(res_H_UM)[res_H_UM$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(res_H_UM$padj) & abs(res_H_UM$log2FoldChange) >= 1]

top_DE_genes <- head(intersect(sig_IM, sig_H), 100)  # Shared top 100
cat("Shared DE genes (padj<0.05, |LFC|≥1):", length(top_DE_genes), "\n")

## Subset normalized counts and ensure genes exist
if(length(top_DE_genes) > 0) {
  top_DE_genes <- intersect(top_DE_genes, rownames(norm_counts))  # Safety intersect
  if(length(top_DE_genes) > 0) {
    deg_mat <- norm_counts[top_DE_genes, ]
    
    # Sample annotation and ensure rownames match colnames
    ann_col <- data.frame(Groups = sample_info$Groups)
    rownames(ann_col) <- colnames(deg_mat)  # Critical for pheatmap

#PHEATMAP
p_deg <- pheatmap(deg_mat,
      scale = "row",  # Z-score per gene for DE visualization
      color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 7, "RdYlBu")))(100),  # Explicit namespace
      cluster_rows = TRUE, 
      cluster_cols = TRUE,
      clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
      clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
      clustering_method = "complete",
      annotation_col = ann_col,
      show_rownames = ifelse(length(top_DE_genes) < 30, TRUE, FALSE),
      show_colnames = FALSE,
      main = paste("Top", length(top_DE_genes), "Shared DE Genes\n(padj<0.05, |LFC|≥1: IM & H vs UM)"),
      fontsize_row = 8,
      filename = file.path(graphics_dir, "heatmap_top_shared_DE_genes.png"),
      width = 12, height = 10
    )
    
## EXPORT
    write.csv(data.frame(Gene = top_DE_genes), 
              file.path(tables_dir, "top_shared_DE_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    
  } else {
    cat("No shared DE genes in norm_counts\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No shared DE genes found\n")
}
writexl::write_xlsx(data.frame(Gene = top_DE_genes), 
              file.path(tables_dir, "top_shared_DE_genes.xlsx"))
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# Set LFC and padj thresholds
padj_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut <- 1

# Function to summarize one contrast
summarize_DEGs <- function(res_df, contrast_name) {
  total_genes <- nrow(res_df)
  
  n_DEG <- sum(res_df$padj < padj_cut, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_LFC1 <- sum(res_df$padj < padj_cut & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cut, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  n_up <- sum(res_df$padj < padj_cut & res_df$log2FoldChange >= lfc_cut, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_down <- sum(res_df$padj < padj_cut & res_df$log2FoldChange <= -lfc_cut, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  percent_sig <- round(100 * n_LFC1 / total_genes, 1)
  
  tibble(
    contrast = contrast_name,
    total_genes = total_genes,
    DEGs_padj05 = n_DEG,
    DEGs_padj05_LFC1 = n_LFC1,
    upregulated = n_up,
    downregulated = n_down,
    percent_sig = percent_sig
  )
}

# Apply to your contrasts
summary_tbl <- bind_rows(
  summarize_DEGs(res_IM_UM_df, "IM_vs_UM"),
  summarize_DEGs(res_H_UM_df, "H_vs_UM")
)

summary_tbl
```

```{r H v UM DEGS}
padj_thresh <- 0.05
lfc_thresh <- 1

## MAKE DEG TABLES
# H v UM
deg_H <- res_H_UM %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%  
  rownames_to_column("TAIR") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(padj < padj_thresh & !is.na(padj) & abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_thresh) %>%
  mutate(direction = case_when(
    log2FoldChange > lfc_thresh ~ "H_UP",
    log2FoldChange < -lfc_thresh ~ "H_DOWN",
    TRUE ~ "NS"
  )) %>%
  filter(direction != "NS") %>%
  mutate(
    symbol = mapIds(org.At.tair.db, keys = TAIR, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "TAIR", multiVals = "first"),
    entrez = mapIds(org.At.tair.db, keys = TAIR, column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "TAIR", multiVals = "first")
  )

# IM vs UM (infected mesophyll)
deg_IM <- res_IM_UM %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("TAIR") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(padj < padj_thresh & !is.na(padj) & abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_thresh) %>%
  mutate(direction = case_when(
    log2FoldChange > lfc_thresh ~ "IM_UP",
    log2FoldChange < -lfc_thresh ~ "IM_DOWN",
    TRUE ~ "NS"
  )) %>%
  filter(direction != "NS") %>%
  mutate(
    symbol = mapIds(org.At.tair.db, keys = TAIR, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "TAIR", multiVals = "first"),
    entrez = mapIds(org.At.tair.db, keys = TAIR, column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "TAIR", multiVals = "first")
  )


## SHARED HAUSTORIA CANDIDATES
shared_tair <- intersect(deg_H$TAIR, deg_IM$TAIR)
deg_shared <- deg_H %>%
  filter(TAIR %in% shared_tair) %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(deg_IM, TAIR, log2FoldChange_IM = log2FoldChange, padj_IM = padj), by = "TAIR") %>%
  mutate(avg_lfc = (log2FoldChange + coalesce(log2FoldChange_IM, 0)) / 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_lfc))

# SPLIT UP/DOWN FOR HEATMAPS
H_UP <- deg_H %>% filter(direction == "H_UP")
H_DOWN <- deg_H %>% filter(direction == "H_DOWN")
IM_UP <- deg_IM %>% filter(direction == "IM_UP")
IM_DOWN <- deg_IM %>% filter(direction == "IM_DOWN")

cat("DE Genes (|LFC| ≥", lfc_thresh, ", padj <", padj_thresh, "):\n")
cat("- H vs UM:    ", nrow(deg_H), " (UP:", nrow(H_UP), " DOWN:", nrow(H_DOWN), ")\n")
cat("- IM vs UM:   ", nrow(deg_IM), " (UP:", nrow(IM_UP), " DOWN:", nrow(IM_DOWN), ")\n")
cat("- Shared:     ", nrow(deg_shared), "\n")

## EXCEL
deg_workbook <- list(
  H_vs_UM_All   = deg_H %>% arrange(padj),
  H_vs_UM_UP    = H_UP,
  H_vs_UM_DOWN  = H_DOWN,
  IM_vs_UM_All  = deg_IM %>% arrange(padj),
  IM_vs_UM_UP   = IM_UP,
  IM_vs_UM_DOWN = IM_DOWN,
  Shared        = deg_shared
)

write_xlsx(deg_workbook, file.path(tables_dir, "DE_genes_all_directions.xlsx"))

## Summary stats
summary_stats <- tibble(
  Contrast = c("H vs UM UP", "H vs UM DOWN", "IM vs UM UP", "IM vs UM DOWN", "Shared"),
  n_genes = c(nrow(H_UP), nrow(H_DOWN), nrow(IM_UP), nrow(IM_DOWN), nrow(deg_shared))
)

library(dplyr)

# Identify significant genes (padj < 0.05 & |LFC| >= 1)
sig_H <- lfc_H_UM_df %>%
  filter(padj < padj_cut & abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cut) %>%
  pull(Gene)

sig_IM <- lfc_IM_UM_df %>%
  filter(padj < padj_cut & abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cut) %>%
  pull(Gene)

# Overlap and unique genes
overlap_genes <- intersect(sig_H, sig_IM)
unique_H <- setdiff(sig_H, sig_IM)
unique_IM <- setdiff(sig_IM, sig_H)

# Summary table
comparison_tbl <- tibble(
  Category = c("H_vs_IM_overlap", "Unique_H_vs_UM", "Unique_IM_vs_UM"),
  n_genes  = c(length(overlap_genes), length(unique_H), length(unique_IM))
)

# Percentages relative to total DEGs in each set
comparison_tbl <- comparison_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    percent_of_H = round(100 * n_genes / length(sig_H), 1),
    percent_of_IM = round(100 * n_genes / length(sig_IM), 1)
  )

comparison_tbl
```

```{r}
## GO ENRICHMENT
tair_list <- list(
  IM_UP   = IM_UP$TAIR[!is.na(IM_UP$TAIR)],
  H_UP    = H_UP$TAIR[!is.na(H_UP$TAIR)],
  IM_DOWN = IM_DOWN$TAIR[!is.na(IM_DOWN$TAIR)],
  H_DOWN  = H_DOWN$TAIR[!is.na(H_DOWN$TAIR)]
)

## SINGLE COMBINED DOTPLOT
go_compare <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = tair_list,
  fun = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb = org.At.tair.db,
  keyType = "TAIR",
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = pad, qvalueCutoff = pad,
  minGSSize = 10
)
p_go_dot <- dotplot(go_compare, showCategory = 10, font.size = 11, label_format = 60) + 
  ggtitle("GO BP Terms: 4-way Comparison (IM_UP/H_UP/IM_DOWN/H_DOWN)")
print(p_go_dot)

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "GO_BP_4way_combined_dotplot.png"), 
       plot = p_go_dot, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved GO BP 4-way combined dotplot\n")

## SUMMARY
go_summary <- tibble(
  Category = c("IM_UP", "H_UP", "IM_DOWN", "H_DOWN"),
  n_genes = c(nrow(IM_UP), nrow(H_UP), nrow(IM_DOWN), nrow(H_DOWN))
)
print(go_summary)


## Individual results for exports
ego_list <- list()
for(category in names(tair_list)) {
  tair_clean <- tair_list[[category]]
  if(length(tair_clean) > 10) {
    ego_list[[category]] <- enrichGO(
      gene = tair_clean,
      OrgDb = org.At.tair.db,
      keyType = "TAIR",
      ont = "BP", 
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff = pad, qvalueCutoff = pad,
      minGSSize = 10
    )
  } else {
    ego_list[[category]] <- NULL
  }
}

## Assign for backward compatibility
ego_IMup   <- ego_list$IM_UP
ego_Hup    <- ego_list$H_UP
ego_IMdown <- ego_list$IM_DOWN
ego_Hdown  <- ego_list$H_DOWN

cat("✅ GO objects assigned: ego_IMup, ego_Hup, ego_IMdown, ego_Hdown\n")
```

```{r}
# Keep individual results for exports (run enrichKEGG separately)
kegg_results <- list()

  entrez_clean <- entrez_list[[category]]
  if(length(entrez_clean) > 10) {
    kegg_results[[category]] <- enrichKEGG(
      gene = entrez_clean,
      organism = "ath",
      keyType = "ncbi-geneid",
      pvalueCutoff = pad, qvalueCutoff = pad,
      minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500,
      use_internal_data = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    kegg_results[[category]] <- NULL
  }
}

  Category = names(kegg_results),
  n_genes_input = sapply(entrez_list, length),
  n_KEGG_terms = sapply(kegg_results, function(x) if(is.null(x)) 0 else nrow(x@result))
)

  # KEGG combined

  # Summary

    Category = names(entrez_list),
    n_genes = sapply(entrez_list, length),
    n_GO_terms = c(nrow(ego_IMup@result), nrow(ego_Hup@result), nrow(ego_IMdown@result), nrow(ego_Hdown@result)),
    n_KEGG_terms = sapply(kegg_results, function(x) if(is.null(x)) 0 else nrow(x@result))
  )
)
```
